title: GI STOCK t=18 against job.toml T = 17.6
rationale: Every value both the GI header and job.toml declare must agree; a disagreement is refused at the GI header line, naming both sources and both values (gi-format 10; PHYS-12). Here the GI STOCK line says t = 18.000 and job.toml T = 17.6; the tower-2 axis agrees. The project design's case list puts this disagreement and the tower-2 axis disagreement in one file; a reader may stop at its first refusal (gi-format 11), so each is its own case (RT27b).
